summary.title: OWASP Cheat Sheet Series
summary.one_liner: A collection of concise, easy-to-read cheat sheets giving application security guidance on specific security topics.
takeaways: The OWASP Cheat Sheet Series is a collection of concise application security cheat sheets.
Each cheat sheet covers a specific application security topic and was written by application security professionals.
The site can be downloaded, and an ATOM feed provides the latest updates.
summary.summary: This is the home page of the OWASP Cheat Sheet Series, a project that collects short, high-value guidance on specific application security topics. The cheat sheets were written by various application security professionals with expertise in those topics. The page links to a downloadable copy of the site and an ATOM feed of updates, plus lists of project leaders, core team members, and project links. The page text is mostly introductory, so it does not list the individual topics covered.
